# How to make your AI brand stand out (when everything else feels the same)

[![](https://review.firstround.com/content/images/size/w1600/2026/05/AI-Powered_Hero-v2-1.png)](https://email2.firstround.com/c/eJxUj01u6zAMBk8j7RyQFEUqCy0e8OB76IdOjDp14Tju9QsH3XT5fRhgMD3XisLeMqom1aCUvD3KvAxzz1Igmqm1ScQYALBNQDD5e9Zr4irSSTkU4pKoaGe51spUC1Y_ZwISiMgYOXG6pAINA1OT1hCKOYZp3p77tr4--6WtD7_k-75_PV3452h0NG52zPZ9-Uudv6OxlqgdhVwYHy78j52NxGBArWlgm3ioV4yDCnSMmAJD91veymHTui3zcepvZ-fbvOf6Wj6Gd7jf8-2-PvffdWT6CQAA___NZ1cG)

In the first couple years after the ChatGPT moment, slapping “AI” on your product was good enough to get buyers to pay attention. It’s not anymore.

“AI powered” worked as a differentiator when it felt new. But that stops being a position when five other credible “AI-powered X” companies are out there. And now there are — because models are shared, infrastructure is abstracted and products that once required months of engineering can launch in days or hours. Worse, all these companies use the same gradients, sterile screenshots and LLM-smoothed copy, making it impossible for customers to tell them apart.

**Arielle Jackson** has spent over a decade working with First Round founders on positioning, brand identity and launch communications. Her advice has shifted a lot over the last two years. The new problem she sees founders faced with: AI accelerates sameness.

In her new piece on The Review, Jackson lays out what founders need to do instead:

1. Start with an opinionated point of view that actually repels some people (intentionally)
2. Create positioning that you revisit every few months as the terrain moves
3. Develop a visual and verbal identity distinctive enough that a competitor copying it would look like a parody

She walks through how Cursor had to reframe its positioning twice in under two years, why Clay’s recent out-of-home campaign is the cleanest expression she’s seen in the category and what Anthropic’s Department of War standoff actually did for Claude’s App Store ranking.

Thanks, as always, for reading and sharing!  

*-The Review Editors*

# Как Шекспира нашли в макулатуре

[![](https://email-images.mindbox.ru/2e8ff1c3-387c-4a08-b8db-2c57933d361c/5.png)](https://tn-sc.mckx.ru/c/UR4pAAAIaOgAwBSO/wyuEBw/o73RnzccO706ejAb/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mann-ivanov-ferber.ru%2F%3Futm_source%3Dmindbox%26utm_medium%3Demail%26utm_campaign%3DAktivnayaBazaKnigiIIxSozdateli27-05-2026)  

[НОВИНКИ](https://tn-sc.mckx.ru/c/UR4pAAAIaOgAwBSO/xCuEBw/wiPNC8lT8z6vPJ1g/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mann-ivanov-ferber.ru%2Fcatalog%2Ftag%2Fnew%2F%3Futm_source%3Dmindbox%26utm_medium%3Demail%26utm_campaign%3DAktivnayaBazaKnigiIIxSozdateli27-05-2026%23books)

  [![](https://email-images.mindbox.ru/bc8ecf04-92c7-4351-8e6d-ab727d65fa61/1.jpeg)](https://tn-sc.mckx.ru/c/UR4pAAAIaOgAwBSO/xSuEBw/LjcxMQBOTIVNfODl/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mann-ivanov-ferber.ru%2Fcatalog%2Fproduct%2Fthe-book-makers%2F%3Futm_source%3Dmindbox%26utm_medium%3Demail%26utm_campaign%3DAktivnayaBazaKnigiIIxSozdateli27-05-2026%23productType%3Dpaperbook%26promoCode%3DSOZDATELI)

Вы замечали, сколько вокруг книг? Дома — полки с любимыми романами, потертые корешки детских сказок, которые перешли по наследству. В телефоне — библиотека на тысячи томов. Книги стали обыденностью, почти воздухом. Мы потребляем текст и редко задумываемся, откуда взялась эта привычная нам форма.

Оксфордский профессор Адам Смит однажды взял в руки фолиант XVII века и заметил на полях смазанный отпечаток пальца. След оставил печатник, который даже представить не мог, что через 400 лет кто-то увидит его прикосновение.

Так начинается новинка [«Книги и их создатели»](https://tn-sc.mckx.ru/c/UR4pAAAIaOgAwBSO/xiuEBw/-lnyPEx0V0d7ej8K/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mann-ivanov-ferber.ru%2Fcatalog%2Fproduct%2Fthe-book-makers%2F%3Futm_source%3Dmindbox%26utm_medium%3Demail%26utm_campaign%3DAktivnayaBazaKnigiIIxSozdateli27-05-2026%23productType%3Dpaperbook%26amp%3BpromoCode%3DSOZDATELI)— рассказ об удивительных людях, чьи руки, ошибки и одержимость сделали книгу такой, какой мы ее знаем сегодня.

[СМОТРЕТЬ](https://tn-sc.mckx.ru/c/UR4pAAAIaOgAwBSO/xyuEBw/w3XJoipJrRYShSKx/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mann-ivanov-ferber.ru%2Fcatalog%2Fproduct%2Fthe-book-makers%2F%3Futm_source%3Dmindbox%26utm_medium%3Demail%26utm_campaign%3DAktivnayaBazaKnigiIIxSozdateli27-05-2026%23productType%3Dpaperbook%26promoCode%3DSOZDATELI)

[на все книги МИФа](https://tn-sc.mckx.ru/c/UR4pAAAIaOgAwBSO/yCuEBw/gx6fG8IqecsFJd4U/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mann-ivanov-ferber.ru%2Fcatalog%2Ftag%2Fnew%2F%3Futm_source%3Dmindbox%26utm_medium%3Demail%26utm_campaign%3DAktivnayaBazaKnigiIIxSozdateli27-05-2026%23books)

Действует до 23:59 (мск) воскресенья, 31 мая. *

## Библия из лоскутов

Англия, 1630-е годы. В уединенной общине Литл-Гиддинг две сестры, Мэри и Анна Коллетт, берут в руки ножи и ножницы. Перед ними — свеженапечатанные экземпляры Евангелия. Девушки начинают разрезать священный текст на кусочки. Предложения, отдельные слова, крохотные буквицы — все идет под лезвие. Вандализм? Кощунство? Ничуть.

На самом деле сестры создавали «Гармонии» — удивительные коллажи, в которых история жизни Христа собиралась из фрагментов сразу четырех канонических текстов. Они клеили, подгоняли, добавляли гравюры лучших европейских мастеров, и постепенно из разрозненных клочков рождалась новая цельность.

Получались книги невероятной красоты и веса — один том весил 23 килограмма и привел в восторг самого короля Карла I, который специально заезжал в Литл-Гиддинг, чтобы увидеть это чудо своими глазами. Эта работа — лучшее доказательство того, что в умелых руках книга становится не застывшей догмой, а живым материалом для творчества и веры.

## Шекспир, завернутый в Цицерона

В 1623 году выходит «Первое фолио» — сборник пьес Уильяма Шекспира. Сегодня за ним охотятся коллекционеры и аукционные дома, а тогда это была просто очередная книга, которую нужно переплести и поставить на полку. В Бодлианской библиотеке заказ отдали Уильяму Уайлдгузу — надежному мастеру «второго эшелона».

Уайлдгуз не читал Шекспира. Его зада

subject: The Ceasefire That Wasn’t
body:
# The Ceasefire That Wasn’t

A couple of weeks ago, I showed you what it looks like when [the world’s most important waterway shuts down](https://substack.com/redirect/25ed4426-64ab-4a5c-90f3-bc72d6b69dc1?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ). 130 ships a day dropping to single digits. Iran’s toll booth. Ships going dark. The data was alarming.

Then on April 7th, Trump gave Iran a deadline to reopen the Strait of Hormuz by 8 PM ET -- or else “a whole civilization will die tonight” -- and by that evening, Pakistan had brokered a two-week truce. Oil futures crashed 15% in minutes. The headlines said the crisis was over.

One week later, a US naval blockade is in effect, the ceasefire exists in name only, Israel has launched a ground assault into southern Lebanon, and Iran is calling the whole thing piracy.

So I loaded up God’s Eye -- swapped in the latest AIS maritime data, overlaid the strike coordinates, and started scrubbing the timeline to see what the data actually says.

**Watch the full video here:**

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/youtube/w_728,c_limit/l_youtube_play_qyqt8q,w_120/7HEUCLc7aL8)](https://substack.com/redirect/d25d50c0-ee1c-488a-a2bf-c4e881e84429?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)

---

## Is It Open?

Before the conflict, roughly 130 ships transited the Strait of Hormuz per day. On the first day of the ceasefire -- April 8th -- 15 got through. The day after: about 6. The oil futures that crashed on the ceasefire announcement? They bounced back above $120 within 24 hours. Traders figured it out faster than the headlines did.  
  
If you scrub through the AIS data in God’s Eye day by day, it’s stark. Where there used to be a constant stream of vessels, there’s just... nothing. A handful of dots where there used to be hundreds.

Trump called the strait “completely, immediately, and safely open.” Then a few days later said Iran was doing a “very poor job” of handling traffic and that “that is not the agreement we have!”

When I started clicking through vessels post-ceasefire, the picture was pretty clear. The ships that are getting through aren’t taking the normal shipping lanes at all. Iran published a map confirming mines in those lanes and is routing ships north, past [Iranian-controlled islands near Larak](https://substack.com/redirect/16821338-5bd7-47cc-97de-6759553bedae?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) -- putting them within range of light artillery from Iranian shores.

The toll booth from the last video? Still operational. $1 to $2 per barrel. A fully loaded VLCC pays $2 to $3 million per transit. IRGC escort, one ship at a time. Insurance premiums have hit 2.5 to 5% of hull value -- we’re talking $600,000 to $1.2 million per trip for a $120 million tanker. Several major insurers pulled Gulf war risk cover entirely. The US doubled its reinsurance backstop to $40 billion to keep the market from freezing.

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!E8lP!,w_1100,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F0cd14572-662a-4fd1-9c34-a8830ae145c5_2861x1819.jpeg)](https://substack.com/redirect/12366f66-c92c-426d-a8cb-8bb547e06f1d?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)

Two bottlenecks. Insurance and Iran. The strait was technically open the way a highway is technically open when every lane is closed except one, and there’s a toll collector with a rifle.

---

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!sbZu!,w_1100,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fd0a6cca4-feed-4f9b-8adf-cc74bfe3466f_3840x2160.jpeg)](https://substack.com/redirect/42dcb00c-5688-4236-89cf-0fd27531690e?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)

subject: Data Hacks and the US-China AI Race

# Data Hacks and the US-China AI Race

*[Trent Kannegieter](https://open.substack.com/users/41018978-trent-kannegieter?utm_source=mentions) is a JD candidate at Yale Law School. Previously, he was Chief of Staff at SparkAI, a machine learning operations and autonomy startup that was acquired by a Fortune 100 company.*

[Mercor](https://substack.com/redirect/5c6fdfe1-3ec1-4784-a3e0-52f078adc7c6?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) isn’t top of mind in DC today, but the expert-data ecosystem it represents is a core determinant of AI capabilities growth and the U.S. frontier AI advantage. Last week’s [hack and data breach at Mercor](https://substack.com/redirect/44f6cd41-9cad-4255-bcf0-a1a6de894128?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ), and the broader security challenge it represents, may shape the future of tech competition. It also could hold the keys to understanding two rapidly vanishing U.S. assets in the field: the specialized-data moat and a differentiable frontier itself.

[![Mercor | Defining the future of work](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!SJbu!,w_534,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F2bcc74fc-afb4-46f6-97ef-fd86d0af5fc8_1206x334.png "Mercor | Defining the future of work")](https://substack.com/redirect/0e457eee-9e18-4808-bfc3-f015bc15e6ea?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)

Mercor is a [$10Bn startup](https://substack.com/redirect/4bdce923-b911-4c69-a79d-cec0c9e544c3?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) that builds specialized human-expert datasets. Firms like Mercor, [Surge AI](https://substack.com/redirect/6741a810-598e-4c5b-b912-5f3214066795?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ), and [Turing](https://substack.com/redirect/cb8aeca2-0e70-47f6-ba0a-fa209330e42e?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)¹ are key to AI capabilities growth, helping labs unlock high performance in new domains. These datasets are one large reason why model performance continues to improve even after foundation-model labs scraped most of the web many training runs ago.

Models are only as good as their data. But one of the greatest challenges in AI development today is finding a way to make new, less-documented fields legible to models. While today’s frontier models have achieved incredible capabilities, they still struggle with [“generalized” reasoning when asked to function in domains where they lack robust training data](https://substack.com/redirect/1113393c-49a3-423b-ae8c-8d1156b03c72?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ).² Thus, one of the key drivers of capabilities growth, especially for the type of white-collar workflow automation critical to helping models complete high-value tasks, is the collection and curation of specialized datasets in expert domains. For example, radiology models train on large corpora of X-rays.³

Mercor specifically conducts these operations through a hiring platform.⁴ As Mercor built this platform’s talent base, it accumulated an impressive set of specialties from [biotech research](https://substack.com/redirect/b3f3090f-9356-4364-887e-0e3cf7b7ce2c?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) and [interventional radiology](https://substack.com/redirect/878ed797-8c87-4265-910d-d5a0ff6fe84d?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) to [corporate law](https://substack.com/redirect/98f66c03-49c8-419a-8f8b-c2df89e1d90b?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) and [international business development](https://substack.com/redirect/547b01eb-ea7f-4636-b762-fdc96caad3dd?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ). This data is incredibly valuable for the labs; when it helps models generate new insights, it unlocks whole new production dom

# The ARR to Cash Leaky Bucket | Build This Bridge

### Brought to you by…[Paraglide](https://substack.com/redirect/5f2fc7ab-1cce-44c8-88e4-262c84116ddd?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!tw5c!,w_1100,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fa931bfb6-67a6-4a4f-8896-86e1d0b2ebb5_1290x210.png)](https://substack.com/redirect/5f2fc7ab-1cce-44c8-88e4-262c84116ddd?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)

My teams have always spent way too much time on billings and collections...chasing customers, sending reminders, providing additional detail, etc. It’s high-volume, boring, and repetitive. Which is exactly why it’s a perfect place to use AI agents.

Have my friends at [Paraglide](https://substack.com/redirect/5f2fc7ab-1cce-44c8-88e4-262c84116ddd?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) tell you what AI agents can do in accounts receivable.

Paraglide helps businesses get paid on time with AI agents that automate billing and collections conversations in the finance inbox. AI agents respond to billing queries, send personalized payment reminders, track commitments, and manage disputes, removing the bottlenecks that delay payment.

[Learn About Collection AI Agents](https://substack.com/redirect/5f2fc7ab-1cce-44c8-88e4-262c84116ddd?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)

---

You are missing out on critical information if you are not bridging ARR to cash based on actuals. Every finance team should be doing it. Many are not…

Few things make a CFO (or CEO with their board) lose credibility quicker than not being able to truly explain the movements between:

1. ARR (or revenue run rate)
2. GAAP revenue
3. Cash collected

A couple of months ago I asked a CEO why their GAAP revenue as a % of ARR had decreased so much over the past 2 years. It was pretty gradual so I don’t think they noticed. It was a 3 percentage point drop, which was $1.5M in revenue that disappeared….What caused it? They dug in and created a bridge and realized they were gradually giving away a lot more free months at the beginning of the contracts. These free months weren’t counted against ARR but must count against revenue.

**A few reasons to create an ARR → Cash Bridge:**

* Discover leaky ARR that doesn’t turn into cash
* Help fine tune forecasting assumptions
* Understand if any policy changes need to be made (too many credits, bad debt, free months, etc)
* If you want to get acquired, diligence will be MUCH easier if you have this ready. Conversely, if you are acquiring a company then make sure to get this.
* Helps significantly with your financial audit

The goal of this bridge is to see how ARR turns into cash. I break the analysis into two separate models:

1. ARR → GAAP Revenue
2. GAAP Revenue → Cash

The first one is usually more art than science. It’s OK if it doesn’t reconcile exactly because you are usually using high-level assumptions.

GAAP revenue to cash is more of a data exercise where you should be able to get pretty exact. My accounting team always puts this together for our auditors and it makes the audit so much easier. And it also significantly helps my FP&A team with their forecasting.

### 1. ARR → Revenue

Your FP&A team ***should*** be factoring all of these things into their forecasts, but not enough companies actually calculate it retrospectively:

* The adjustment section (highlighted in red) is the hard/important part
* Breaking out the adjustment detail helps find process/policy issues
* Updating this analysis regularly highlights changes that might get hidden in FP&A’s forecast vs actual review
* Makes the CFO’s job explaining the movement a lot easier (builds confidence)

# [AINews] Anthropic launches the MCP Apps open spec, in Claude.ai

> *AI News for 1/23/2026-1/26/2026. We checked 12 subreddits, **[544](https://substack.com/redirect/30f9d458-bf87-4bc5-a500-43542a1b8114?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)** [Twitters](https://substack.com/redirect/30f9d458-bf87-4bc5-a500-43542a1b8114?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) and **24** Discords (**206** channels, and **14285** messages) for you. Estimated reading time saved (at 200wpm): **1208 minutes**. **[Our new website](https://substack.com/redirect/b026cf7c-7022-4477-aadd-d91688c88389?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)** is now up with full metadata search and beautiful vibe coded presentation of all past issues.*
>
> *As a reminder, [AINews is now a section of Latent Space](https://substack.com/redirect/37f478a1-f45d-41c5-8ec0-90d8a1438446?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ). You can [opt in/out](https://substack.com/redirect/d33c697a-15bc-42bc-9ccb-b132a8ded92b?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) of email frequencies!*

3 months after OpenAI floated a trial balloon with [ChatGPT Apps and the Apps SDK at Dev Day 2025](https://substack.com/redirect/3cb8963a-5cf1-476b-996a-f6e29a87b557?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ), Anthropic has now officially absorbed [the independent MCP UI project](https://substack.com/redirect/2224f811-2226-4707-bad6-62b5b7f78aea?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) and, working with OpenAI, Block, VS Code, Antigravity, JetBrains, AWS, and others, has released both:

* [the MCP Apps spec](https://substack.com/redirect/1468ff65-548b-4865-bc6b-93713bebfe54?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)
* [official support in Claude.ai](https://substack.com/redirect/6a57d009-a4b3-4db6-ab18-251e8da4f662?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) - comparatively very well received but of course not as popular as [the Claude in Excel announcement](https://substack.com/redirect/d48d6025-640c-47c8-87e5-e6231c5f1cf8?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ).

It’s fair to say that ChatGPT Apps haven’t exactly taken the world by storm since announcement, but the overall need for a standard format for applications to return rich UI still cannot be denied.

Now that MCP Apps have been ratified by all the important players, this is the basis for a rich ecosystem of open source support and applications being able to interoperate, and perhaps one day solve the perpetual never ending pile of $20/month subscriptions piling up in your credit card bills.

As a reminder, we interviewed David Soria Parra and the rest of the AAIF, who previewed a bit of the thinking and design process behind MCP Apps here:

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/youtube/w_728,c_limit/l_youtube_play_qyqt8q,w_120/z6XWYCM3Q8s)](https://substack.com/redirect/dfa46bb3-a121-46b0-aea4-d05919c1411d?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)

---

**Agent Orchestration, RLMs, and “Clawdbot/Clawd” as a UX pattern**

* **NVIDIA ToolOrchestra + Orchestrator-8B**: NVIDIA’s ToolOrchestra frames agentic systems as a *small “conductor” model* that alternates reasoning with calls to tools and larger “expert” models (search, code execution, specialist LLMs, frontier generalists). The claim is that an **8B orchestrator** can reach *frontier-level outcomes* via delegation at materially lower cost, trained end-to-end with **scalable RL** using automatically synthesized tool-use environments and multi-turn tasks ([summary](https://substack.com/redirect/c3b76d0f-82a7-41c7-93e0-42e3e130d4bd?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ), [link](https://substack.com/redirect/1588dcb4-4f34-4931-821a-759a69b60c21?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQ

# 🏕 Когда Лила выходит на природу

[![](https://static.tildacdn.com/tild6239-3630-4631-a365-643332623230/-05_1.png)](https://geteml.com/ru/mail_link_tracker?hash=6n71cwz9mgj64dkwxk33t9wjwbcs9kjiou8i664w1nf3r3ifyo97sts1o4rb55oio59iqxecr7nejztggapdqz7i4fuhwh1m5dhcbi1o&url=aHR0cHM6Ly9vbWthcmEubWFya2V0&uid=NjY5NDE5NA~~&ucs=d67de86ed71ac053bbca04df5c584151)

OMKARA Маркет

Онлайн-магазин особенных артефактов

               [![](https://static.tildacdn.com/tild3433-6233-4064-b839-613636613262/Desktop_-_173.png)](https://geteml.com/ru/mail_link_tracker?hash=64zyj58nur7er7kwxk33t9wjwbcs9kjiou8i664w1nf3r3ifyo9715gfnc94iy8ksygn6rudocumfhjrrey1gm5nchbxfbxi8sspmuce&url=aHR0cHM6Ly9vbWthcmEubWFya2V0L2NhdGFsb2c_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1lbWFpbG1hcmtldA~~&uid=NjY5NDE5NA~~&ucs=2b84443c762efa1400a67a5f9e2c25ff)

🏕 Майское солнце и тепло выманивают нас из привычных залов и студий. Наверняка вы и сами ловили себя на мысли, как красиво было бы развернуть большое напольное поле прямо в парке или где-то у воды.

Игры вне стен всегда имеют особую глубину, потому что сама природа начинает активно участвовать в процессе. Меняется и восприятие артефактов. Они перестают быть просто инструментами и начинают буквально взаимодействовать с окружающей средой.

                                     [![](https://static.tildacdn.com/tild6136-3964-4432-b339-613964663332/Screenshot_2026-05-2.png)](https://geteml.com/ru/mail_link_tracker?hash=6n67jt1datjtuzkwxk33t9wjwbcs9kjiou8i664w1nf3r3ifyo97iueodbfcriwt4ka5nnnt3jjethjrrey1gm5nchbxfbxi8sspmuce&url=aHR0cHM6Ly9vbWthcmEubWFya2V0L2NhdGFsb2c_dGZjX3N0b3JlcGFydHVpZCU1Qjc0OTQxMDA3OSU1RD3QmNCz0YDQvtCy0YvQtSvQv9C-0LvRjyZ0ZmNfZGl2PTo6Oj91dG1fc291cmNlPWVtYWlsbWFya2V0&uid=NjY5NDE5NA~~&ucs=63372f2749d0de25d6ccebc1333d9747) [**Игровые поля вступают в прямой диалог с пространством.**](https://geteml.com/ru/mail_link_tracker?hash=6n8fupzywbxpc5kwxk33t9wjwbcs9kjiou8i664w1nf3r3ifyo97stonanao783ofka5nnnt3jjethjrrey1gm5nchbxfbxi8sspmuce&url=aHR0cHM6Ly9vbWthcmEubWFya2V0L2NhdGFsb2c_dGZjX3N0b3JlcGFydHVpZCU1Qjc0OTQxMDA3OSU1RD3QmNCz0YDQvtCy0YvQtSvQv9C-0LvRjyZ0ZmNfZGl2PTo6Oj91dG1fc291cmNlPWVtYWlsbWFya2V0&uid=NjY5NDE5NA~~&ucs=63372f2749d0de25d6ccebc1333d9747)

- «Агни» резонирует с энергией солнца, добавляя практике динамики и готовности к изменениям.
- «Притхви», наоборот, помогает удерживать опору на живой земле, чтобы участники не «разлетались» в осознаниях, а проживали их с чувством внутреннего фундамента.

          [Исследовать коллекцию полей](https://geteml.com/ru/mail_link_tracker?hash=66iaiqms9ezzszkwxk33t9wjwbcs9kjiou8i664w1nf3r3ifyo97w5yuy5qrodazhka5nnnt3jjethjrrey1gm5nchbxfbxi8sspmuce&url=aHR0cHM6Ly9vbWthcmEubWFya2V0L2NhdGFsb2c_dGZjX3N0b3JlcGFydHVpZCU1Qjc0OTQxMDA3OSU1RD3QmNCz0YDQvtCy0YvQtSvQv9C-0LvRjyZ0ZmNfZGl2PTo6Oj91dG1fc291cmNlPWVtYWlsbWFya2V0&uid=NjY5NDE5NA~~&ucs=63372f2749d0de25d6ccebc1333d9747) [![](https://static.tildacdn.com/tild3665-3266-4430-b264-623736633963/Screenshot_2026-05-2.png)](https://geteml.com/ru/mail_link_tracker?hash=6sqtzfcnpfjxjjkwxk33t9wjwbcs9kjiou8i664w1nf3r3ifyo97ohk1gkn5g5hezg76j9aoej7jjqjrrey1gm5nchbxfbxi8sspmuce&url=aHR0cHM6Ly9vbWthcmEubWFya2V0L2NhdGFsb2c_dGZjX3N0b3JlcGFydHVpZCU1Qjc0OTQxMDA3OSU1RD3QmNCz0YDQvtCy0YvQtSvQutGD0LHQuNC60LgmdGZjX2Rpdj06Ojo_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1lbWFpbG1hcmtldA~~&uid=NjY5NDE5NA~~&ucs=a8796417ad247e873b60246155e814f4) [**Деревянные кубики**](https://geteml.com/ru/mail_link_tracker?hash=68kexuiad816t7kwxk33t9wjwbcs9kjiou8i664w1nf3r3ifyo97sddfu9j6w8cqxg76j9aoej7jjqjrrey1gm5nchbxfbxi8sspmuce&url=aHR0cHM6Ly9vbWthcmEubWFya2V0L2NhdGFsb2c_dGZjX3N0b3JlcGFydHVpZCU1Qjc0OTQxMDA3OSU1RD3QmNCz0YDQvtCy0YvQtSvQutGD0LHQuNC60LgmdGZjX2Rpdj06Ojo_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1lbWFpbG1hcmtldA~~&uid=NjY5NDE5NA~~&ucs=a8796417ad247e873b60246155e814f4)

# Surpresas boas — e seguras 💐

![Banner XP Investimentos - Dia das mães](https://mfe.xpi.com.br/authentication-assets/emails/xp/headers/header-mothers-day-v2.png) O Dia das Mães está chegando - um momento especial de celebrar e presentear quem a gente ama. Para
 ajudar você a aproveitar essa data da forma que merece, reunimos algumas dicas de segurança para
 fazer suas compras com tranquilidade, evitar golpes e proteger quem é importante para você.

![Banner XP Investimentos - Dia das mães - Cartão Temporário](https://mfe.xpi.com.br/authentication-assets/emails/xp/presentation/temporary-card.png) ![Ícone de segurança](https://mfe.xpi.com.br/authentication-assets/emails/common/security-green-icon.png) Agora, para não cair em golpes, siga essas dicas:

![Ícone de alerta](https://mfe.xpi.com.br/authentication-assets/emails/xp/icons/alert-circle-icon.png)

Pagamento de taxa para receber um presente?
 Desconfie!

Se você ou alguém da sua família receber uma entrega surpresa e, para ficar com o presente,
 for preciso pagar uma taxa ou permitir que tirem uma foto para confirmar o recebimento,
 cuidado: é golpe.

![Ícone de monitor](https://mfe.xpi.com.br/authentication-assets/emails/xp/icons/monitor-icon.png)

Na internet, verifique se o site é oficial

Antes de comprar, confirme se o endereço do site é realmente o da loja. Evite realizar
 pagamentos clicando em links de anúncios em redes sociais ou recebidos por mensagem.

![Ícone de usuário](https://mfe.xpi.com.br/authentication-assets/emails/xp/icons/user-check-icon.png)

Sempre revise antes de pagar

Antes de confirmar uma compra via boleto ou PIX, confira valor, nome do recebedor e
 CNPJ/CPF. Se algo estiver diferente do combinado ou do site oficial, não conclua o
 pagamento.

![Ícone de alerta vermelho](https://mfe.xpi.com.br/authentication-assets/emails/common/error-red-icon.png)

**Fui vítima de um golpe.** O que fazer?

Por segurança, entre em contato com o nosso atendimento o quanto antes:

![Ícone de Whatsapp](https://mfe.xpi.com.br/authentication-assets/emails/xp/icons/whatsapp-icon.png) **WhatsApp:** (11) 4935-2720

![Ícone de telefone](https://mfe.xpi.com.br/authentication-assets/emails/xp/icons/phone-calling-icon.png) **Telefone:** (11) 4003-3710 (Capitais/Regiões Metropolitanas) ou  
0800-880-3710 (Demais Localidades)

Compartilhe essas dicas para proteger todos ao seu redor.

![XP Investimentos - Segurança](https://mfe.xpi.com.br/authentication-assets/emails/authentication/xp/footer_xp_v1.png)

# Not Another Dev Tool

**A special announcement today from my incredible spouse, who is on the hunt for a CTO and cofounder.**

**Marrying her was the best decision I ever made. Starting a company with her may be the best one you make!**

---

Once upon a time, I saw the Komodo dragons in their natural habitat. They were majestic, imposing and the chill they sent down my spine was unforgettable. I am no dragonologist, but a friend and I decided to meet up midway, and that landed us on the Komodo island.

For me, it’s the adventures that give life its magic and the most epic ones start with companions who expand our worlds and draw us to unexpected wonders.

Today, I am seeking a partner to embark on the ultimate commercial adventure: entrepreneurship.

Perhaps you are about to team up with another developer to build another dev tool, but ***let me open the door to a whole new world for you***. If this goes well, we’ll spend the next decade together with an exceptional team of fellow adventurers to push the frontier of a real industry.

### **You might be a good fit if you are:**

1. Based in NYC
2. Already committed to starting a company
3. As good at your craft (ML+data) as I am at mine (see below)
4. Open-minded but decisive
5. Ambitious; our approach will be frontier and radical, not midwit or marginal
6. Down for a 10-year adventure, which may or may not involve riches or glory, but will definitely involve great people and honorable work

### **About me:**

1. I am 10 years out of college, had some big responsibilities professionally, and am now also raising a toddler with Jordan!
2. As a private equity investor for 7 years, I evaluated hundreds of companies (and founders). My portfolio companies exceed $5bn in total valuation, ranging widely from $3mm to $2bn. On this adventure, I developed clarity of thought, a sense for order of magnitude and taste in people
3. As an operator in recent years, I defined strategies, closed deals, opened new markets, ran payroll, delivered hiring and firing decisions, etc. On this adventure, I recognized how much I have to give. One startup I coached received a ~100% valuation increase after I rebuilt the narrative and told them the numbers to ask
4. Over the years, I earned the trust of some people who think the world of me
5. I go very deep into very niche topics, in order to do that I have a high bar for what’s worthwhile; I will work 24/7 when called for, but not 996 every week
6. I consider the ultimate job of a CEO to defy gravity, as most companies see their upside shrink overtime. I have watched this happen up close twice, painfully. If I get this right, it will not be me alone - although I do have great instincts - but because our trust in each other keeps us honest, in perspective and relentless

### **The idea space:**

**You may have guessed, dear smart reader, that if the idea space was “sexy” I would have put it in the first paragraph. But remember, I am looking to expand worlds (yours and mine); you don’t need to be an insider because you have me.**

This is a multi-trillion dollar industry with highly specialized talent. It was Franz Kafka’s day job and the core engine of Warren Buffett’s empire. High walls surround it but the people inside are generous, smart and fun!

Welcome to the world of insurance.

I have invested in insurance companies and operated within insurance companies as General Manager and VP of Finance. We won’t be selling insurance policies. We’ll solve structural, heavy-lifting, legacy tech debt that can build us a data moat to move the entire industry to the agentic era. Few trillion-dollar industries have this opportunity still on the table.

I have a hypothesis and people to call; we will work together on the strategy, product and plan. And if you have a better idea outside insurance, let’s pressure-test both.

**Interested? Use this [form](https://substack.com/redirect/22fceb10-748e-4353-a49a-9f9ae7f742ce?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkX

# Linear #166: Agents Can Pull Data from Systems of Record, A New Age in Advertising

---

Today’s newsletter is sponsored by [Xplor Pay.](https://substack.com/redirect/d22c0977-a8c8-4d28-87e1-8b7a68f21037?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) If you’re attending TRANSACT 2026 in Atlanta, stop by Booth #717 to learn how you can unlock new revenue streams, scale faster, and streamline the payment experience.

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!nNqA!,w_550,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F13b4d8fd-95cc-4a07-a104-c50428e448a0_600x200.gif)](https://substack.com/redirect/bdd72ed6-75fb-4f0e-9ac0-f70ac15aec90?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)

They’re hosting an espresso bar in their booth on Thursday, March 19th, starting at 9 a.m. Stop by if you’re at the show and receive a surprise gift! Learn about PayFac as a Service with [Xplor Pay.](https://substack.com/redirect/bdd72ed6-75fb-4f0e-9ac0-f70ac15aec90?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)

---

Alright, let’s get to it…

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!JlAB!,w_1100,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F8033a6fa-d446-4ceb-9f5f-6fbfdce0b6b6_1875x625.jpeg)](https://substack.com/redirect/d68dcb94-a302-428c-8ae4-2446e4465f97?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)

Most companies have a “systems of record are holding our data hostage” problem.  
  
Your ERP / EHR / LMS / ancient desktop app has the data BUT...  
-no API  
-exports are janky  
-the only person who knows how it works is “Steve in accounting”  
-every “integration project” turns into a 6-month archaeology dig  
  
Agents can technically solve this.   
  
They can:  
1. Open the system (yes, the UI)  
2. Navigate like a human would  
3. Pull the fields you need  
4. Reconcile the mess (“Acct #” vs “AccountID” vs “Customer Code”)  
push clean data into the real workflow (CRM, warehouse, dashboard)

This is bigger than “integration pain.” It’s a **strategic shift** in what it means to be a system of record… and what it means to have a moat.

[![No alternative text description for this image](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!SYcG!,w_1100,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ff220a595-506c-46c5-a156-6ad39268bbdb_800x446.jpeg "No alternative text description for this image")](https://substack.com/redirect/f30bbff9-fb6c-4342-8a26-81d1bac51b82?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)

## Part 1: What this means for *systems of record* (SoRs)

Historically, systems of record won because they became the “source of truth” and then (intentionally or not) **held the data hostage**.

Not always maliciously. Often it’s just reality:

* The vendor never built the API surface area.
* The data model is too messy to safely expose.
* The product team optimized for “get the job done,” not “enable the ecosystem.”
* The business logic lives in UI flows, stored procedures, and tribal knowledge.

So the SoR becomes the *place where work happens* and also the *place where data gets trapped*.

### The agentic wedge: “UI as the integration layer”

Agents change the rules because they can do what humans do:

1. Open the system (yes, the UI)
2. Navigate like a human
3. Pull the fields you need
4. Reconcile the mess (“Acct #” vs “AccountID” vs “Customer Code”)
5. Push clean data into the *real workflow* (CRM, warehouse, dashboards)

This is the same conceptual promise RPA has had for years—bridging systems **when APIs aren’t available**—but agents bring a more flexible “understand + adapt” layer on top of it. Oracle even calls this out directly: RPA “bridges systems that lack APIs” to keep data flowing end-to-end.

Danny, you're invited to

 

Tuesday, April 21

 

An MBA costs $100K+, and too many people just figure out how to pay for it after they enroll—don't be that person! For this event Leland has partnered with Juno, an organization dedicated to negotiating better student loans for a community of undergraduate families, grad students and more.

In 60 minutes, you'll know exactly which loans to take, which to avoid and how to keep debt from derailing your career. Also, three lucky attendees will win a $100 gift card!  

This session covers:  
• Understanding federal vs. private loans and how to compare your options effectively  
• Juno's collective bargaining model that helps students access competitive rates  
• Practical strategies for managing MBA debt during school and after graduation

subject: Best growth hack by Grasshopper`s CEO
body:
# Best growth hack by Grasshopper`s CEO

IT'S 2026! ==> People always ask me for what I read and where I get my info. Lucky for you I've quietly started a newsletter for everything startups -- get on it here ===> https://www.GreatStartups.com/newsletter/?utm_source=ghi&utm_medium=nl&utm_campaign=gs

Grasshopper's conversions increased when they published their entrepreneur story on the homepage.

After 12 years [Grasshopper](http://www.grasshopper.com/) had **$30M+ in revenue**, over 150,000 customers and was bought by [Citrix](http://grasshopper.com/citrix-acquires-grasshopper/).  

David, CEO of Grasshopper, shared one of his most memorable growth hacking tricks.  

One of the guys that was doing A/B testing for them offered to put founder’s photos on the homepage and tell the **entrepreneur story**, how they started, why, struggles, etc."  

They did it and, all of a sudden, conversions increased.  

![](http://e.growthhackingidea.com/files/e.growthhackingidea.com/general/avatar.png)Cheers,  
Charlie Patel ;)  

Want to hang out with fellow growth marketers and SaaS founders who love amazing deals. [**Join the FB Group**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/startupandsaasgrowth/)

**Virtual Panel** | *Donor-exclusive event*

April 27, 2026 - 11:00 a.m. (UTC-4)

[![](https://dim.mcusercontent.com/cs/856e1833b3143071925bb58a3/images/6f1c619d-c8be-c249-b368-5a74ac220e66.png?dpr=2&rect=0%2C0%2C835%2C176&w=628&h=132)](https://insightcrime.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=856e1833b3143071925bb58a3&id=6f202e0845&e=d724a24a62)

What seizures tell us about today’s cocaine market.

The global cocaine market is expanding. As new hubs in Europe continue to pop up, violence is growing. In Asia and Oceania, cocaine seizures are breaking records – including in countries where cocaine use was uncommon. Expanding markets also means expanding profits for organized crime.

As authorities crack down in one place, traffickers rise up in another. Organized crime continues to find creative  ways to sneak past these checks. So what can be done to stem the growth of transnational drug trafficking organizations?

# Claude 201 for GTM operators: context files, skills, and the tools that connect

> [![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!mP2n!,w_1100,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fe6797aab-f024-45a1-8777-41833cd30286_1920x1080.png "")](https://substack.com/redirect/e1513dd1-7947-4fe8-a5d1-52a58dc13c38?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)
>
> Your team’s account plans are built in PowerPoint, presented once, and never opened again. By the time the plan is done it’s already wrong. Contacts have changed, signals have moved, and your biggest accounts are quietly testing competitors. **[Kandir](https://substack.com/redirect/eb314232-ebc3-4199-b153-dbbe3bd7a60c?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)** builds a living, signal-enriched account plan in under 5 minutes, backed by real intel from sellers who’ve already sold to your target accounts. **[Try it free for 7 days](https://substack.com/redirect/eb314232-ebc3-4199-b153-dbbe3bd7a60c?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)**
>
> **Thanks to our sponsors who keep this email free. Interested in sponsoring these emails? See our [partnership options here](https://substack.com/redirect/48d573c0-5e18-4deb-bfe5-06fd6cd5a669?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)**

---

Most GTM operators are getting value from Claude. They are also leaving most of it on the table.

The typical pattern is querying Claude the way you would query a smarter Google, except with better follow-up questions. One session, one task, no persistent context. The output is only as good as what you explained in that window. Close the tab and everything resets. Open a new conversation and start over.

The 201 move is different. It is building a configured working environment that Claude inhabits whenever you start a conversation. That environment has three layers: a context file that tells Claude what it needs to know about your business, skills that encode how you want recurring tasks executed, and MCP connections that give Claude live access to your tools. Each layer compounds the others.

This is not a setup-once-and-forget configuration. It is a working environment you refine over time, and it gets materially better the more specific you make it. A generic setup produces generic output. A properly configured environment produces output you can send.

---

*A new AI for GTM course starting next week. There’s still time to join.*

[Enroll](https://substack.com/redirect/40fb95ef-63d8-469a-9ad2-7989b23d6c13?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)

---

## The three layers

To get Claude working for your GTM use cases I suggest setting up at least these three: Context, Skills, and MCPs. These are specific to the Claude ecosystem.

Think of it this way. Context files are what Claude knows. Skills are what Claude does. MCPs are what Claude can reach. Operate with all three configured and Claude functions less like a smart text generator and more like a second operator who already knows your business.

Most GTM operators building with Claude today have partial versions of all three. They have a Project with some documents uploaded, a handful of prompts they reuse, and maybe one or two connections active. The gap between that and a properly configured environment is not technical complexity. It is specificity. The question is not whether you have these layers. It is whether what you have built is specific enough to be useful at the task level.

Before going deeper on each layer, it is worth being precise about which Claude product you are working in, because the mechanics differ enough to matter.

# Ative o Modo Protegido e tenha mais segurança na rua

[Ver no navegador.](https://click.sfmc.itau.com.br/?%3D%3D)
![Logo Uniclass](https://www.itau.com.br/media/dam/m/6918be931d783994/original/pre-header-uniclass-azul.png)![](https://www.itau.com.br/media/dam/m/3bfe9e402cda7e09/original/00-BM0008118-1770303404-png.png) 

Olá, Daniil

A gente quer sair com o celular na rua sem preocupações. Por isso, agora o app Itaú tem o **Modo Protegido**, a nova camada de proteção que garante mais segurança em casos de roubo ou furto de celular.  
  
Ative para curtir o Carnaval com mais leveza.

[Ativar Modo Protegido](https://click.sfmc.itau.com.br/?%3D%3D "Ativar Modo Protegido")
![](https://www.itau.com.br/media/dam/m/1092cfb2eeb17633/original/lock_base-FFFFFF-ELLIPSE-0131FF.png)

O que é o Modo Protegido?

É uma nova camada de proteção do app Itaú, onde você determina seus locais seguros e recebe sugestões de redes seguras com base na sua rotina. Ela identifica quando você está dentro dos locais configurados e permite definir um limite máximo diário para suas transações quando você estiver fora desses locais, garantindo mais segurança em caso de roubo ou furto de celular.

![](https://www.itau.com.br/media/dam/m/2be84c268a87a259/original/information_base-FFFFFF-ELLIPSE-0131FF.png)

E como funciona?

Se for necessário realizar transações fora de um local seguro e acima do limite definido, será solicitada uma confirmação de identidade por meio de biometria facial, garantindo que a transação esteja sendo feita por você.  
  
Em breve, você também poderá ocultar seus investimentos fora de locais seguros. 

![](https://www.itau.com.br/media/dam/m/5f5d72af6b5434c3/original/check_base-FFFFFF-ELLIPSE-0131FF.png)

Ativar o Modo Protegido é fácil:

* Garanta que todas as camadas de proteção do app estejam ativas.
* Depois, é só cadastrar suas redes Wi-Fi seguras e definir o limite de valor para transações fora dessas redes.

![](https://www.itau.com.br/media/dam/m/75d1e26d67f62a96/original/IU-regua-03-ajustado.gif)

**É** rápido, gratuito e pode  
ser feito em qualquer lugar.

[Ativar Modo Protegido](https://click.sfmc.itau.com.br/?%3D%3D "Ativar Modo Protegido")
  

Diz pra gente: este conteúdo foi útil pra você?

[![](https://www.itau.com.br/media/dam/m/645b5ed4e324b34d/original/like-laranja.png)](https://click.sfmc.itau.com.br/?%3D%3D "Sim, gostei")[![](https://www.itau.com.br/media/dam/m/59b148e28fece282/original/dislike-laranja.png)](https://click.sfmc.itau.com.br/?qs=eyJkZWtJZCI6ImRiNzQxNWY5LTBmYzMtNGVhMS0

subject: 5 of my favorite new retention techniques that you may not have tried
body:
# 5 of my favorite new retention techniques that you may not have tried

Retention is life. It’s the ultimate Product-Market Fit feedback loop. It’s how you know whether your product is actually lovable or not. This means the opportunities for improvement are endless. And even though I’ve been obsessed with improving paid user retention for a [long](https://substack.com/redirect/1a34f86e-dc37-4a77-8dcf-9a78471d2f07?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) [long](https://substack.com/redirect/50950238-314c-450c-98d5-6a1f15fbdec7?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) [long](https://substack.com/redirect/7d5457bf-5ffe-48ed-821b-c92514e78c6e?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) [long](https://substack.com/redirect/143ba6cf-fd62-4f01-bf77-ba1909481677?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) time, I’m still finding new approaches.

Here are a few that we’ve recently tested… which all yielded a meaningful lift!

Plus, 2 laws of retention improvement that everyone keeps forgetting.

---

***Sponsored by [Churnkey](https://substack.com/redirect/c224e74b-58af-4eb9-823f-c1e171ae2213?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ),** the platform that helps companies save 20–40% of subscription revenue that would otherwise be lost to churn. Used by best-in-class companies like Superhuman to proactively improve retention. Their new [Feedback AI](https://substack.com/redirect/6191d38b-e48c-4839-ac54-ab964177e8e3?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ) even maps churn feedback to MRR lost so you know exactly what to build next. [Learn more →](https://substack.com/redirect/c224e74b-58af-4eb9-823f-c1e171ae2213?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)*

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Xzf_!,w_453,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F65767336-9497-4af6-92bc-645aed5cc58c_1000x524.png)](https://substack.com/redirect/324b0484-06da-4f5a-a134-66a5d8836239?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)

## #1 - Adding a ‘lite’ plan to the cancellation flow

When you’re doing a cancellation flow, the most important thing to ask at *minimum* is: ‘Why are you leaving?’ It’s so important for you to understand what’s driving this decision for the user. As I’ve [said before](https://substack.com/redirect/f5bf2cde-6d4f-4afb-bd07-2ceb795d2e17?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ): *Always, always ask why people are churning. Most reasons fall into these buckets and have the following distribution of responses:*

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!zC-Y!,w_483,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F923b2e2e-e5f7-473e-be69-d516b856af6a_1200x742.png)](https://substack.com/redirect/678edb28-6302-444c-90b4-620f18e5957a?j=eyJ1IjoiNndtMGMifQ.FKZnV4yDO9r1W3mXiFPvoTkXx7p4iMXPKOi9UqQpNhQ)

Source: Churnkey

“Too expensive” and ‘“Don’t need it anymore” will almost always be your top reasons for churn. This is where discounting and engagement efforts should deliver a lot of value. The rest are red flags for your core product team to deal with.

If you’re trying to save a customer who’s no longer an active day-to-day user, a lever to pull is introduce what I call the Keep the Lights On (KTLO!) plan. This is a plan for customers who still have things running on the platform or need minimal ongoing access, but don’t need full usage anymore. They keep the core functionality they rely on, while shedding the heavier, more expensive usage layer.

So at Lovable, instead of saying ‘Sorry, you either pay the full $25/month price or lose all of the functionality’... we created a Lite Plan that allows users to keep access to the paid features only, but without any additional credits
